tagline: Your next suburban train in Tunis, in one glance.
hero_alt: A blue and silver suburban train waiting at a platform in Tunis
station_alt: Tunis Ville railway station seen across the fountain square
empty_select: Choose your line, your current station and your destination to see the next trains.
empty_same: Departure and destination are the same. Choose a different destination.
empty_none: No train serves both stations today or tomorrow. Express trains may skip one of them.
load_error: The timetable could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
info_hub: Tunis Ville is the hub of lines A, D and E. Every line runs between Tunis and its suburban terminus.
info_express: Trains marked Express skip some stations. Only trains that stop at both of your stations are shown.
info_days: Sunday and public-holiday timetables are applied automatically, using Tunisia time.
footer: Unofficial app. Timetable: SNCFT Banlieue de Tunis, Winter 2026–2027 (1 Sep 2026 – 30 Jun 2027). Always check at the station.
fallback_missing: The {expected} timetable is not published yet. Showing the {using} timetable — times may differ.
fallback_outdated: No timetable has been published for this date yet. Showing the {name} — times may be outdated.
fallback_none: No timetable is available for this line yet.
ramadan_auto: Ramadan dates are calculated automatically and may differ by one day from the official announcement.
ramadan_starts_tomorrow: Check the official announcement: the Ramadan timetable may start tomorrow.
ramadan_ends_tomorrow: Check the official announcement: the Ramadan timetable may end tomorrow.
